delivered.statement: Q3 FY26 revenue INR 13,757 million with 3-year CAGR growth in 9M period
Pharma delivered 50% year-on-year growth with new customer additions
Gross margin expanded to 59% in Q3 with favorable product mix
EBITDA margin of 27% for 9-month period remains resilient
Commercialized 5 new molecules in AgChem exports, 4 in domestic
10% growth in new products in AgChem export demonstrates derisking strategy
Launched 3 new herbicides (Alcor, Comet, Fixit) and insecticide Uranus
Harpin αβ peptide platform approved in India; filings ongoing in US, Latin America
PI improved S&P Global Sustainability ranking to 98th percentile, featured in yearbook

themes: Global crop protection market in extended down cycle with destocking, soft pricing, margin pressure
India agrochemical demand subdued due to elevated channel inventory and low commodity prices
Pharma platform strong at 50% YoY growth; biologicals scaling toward global franchise
Product launches and portfolio diversification strategy to derisking and capture new business
Working capital elevated to 139 days reflecting customer accommodation in weak market
Electronic chemicals and specialty chemicals emerging as new growth platforms
risks: Extended global demand softness and price compression for generic agrochemicals may persist
Geopolitical uncertainties and biotech funding cycles lengthening pharma opportunity conversion timelines
Working capital increase from 68 to 139 days due to customer needs; recovery uncertain
Pharma EBITDA positivity timeline pushed out, dependent on reaching INR 400-500 crore topline

analyst_pushback.question: Is Q4 growth YoY or only sequential?
analyst_pushback.response: Volume growth expected Q4 onwards; momentum building into FY27

analyst_pushback.question: Gross margin sustainability at 59% vs 50-52% long-term guidance?
analyst_pushback.response: Track EBITDA not quarterly GM; product mix varies; FY27 guidance at year-end

analyst_pushback.question: FY27 growth guidance: mid or high single digit?
analyst_pushback.response: Too early for specific guidance; provided at year-end per historical practice

analyst_pushback.question: New product growth slowed in Q3 despite strong H1?
analyst_pushback.response: 10-year development cycle normal; growth accelerates as industry normalizes

tone_evidence: Acknowledges near-term headwinds and extended down cycle, but confident fundamentals and FY27 recovery
